messages:
sasha: Heads-up — onboarding run for quantized-ggml-7b shows a huge NDCG hit (~12%) vs float baseline on MTEB-like retrieval. Run id: run_175800. Attached summary and logs.

mike: Can you paste the eval summary numbers? quick diff pls.

sasha: Sure — from the eval artifact:```
baseline (float32): ndcg@10=0.712, mrr=0.431
quantized (int8 post-train): ndcg@10=0.625, mrr=0.389
```
Also runner config: ```runner.batch_size=64
runner.seed=42
collector.group_by = f"{dataset}:{model}"
```
Commit: a1b2c3d, quantize script used: tools/quantize/post_static_int8.py

rebecca: Did you confirm same FAISS index + normalization? sometimes quant scripts flip dims ordering if you do float->quant in-place.

sasha: Confirmed — index dump sha256 matches baseline index. Normalization done before quantization. Same seed.

dinesh: I tried to reproduce locally. Individual fold-level metrics look close to baseline (folds: 0.70,0.71,0.69) for baseline and (0.68,0.67,0.66) for quantized — small diffs. The large ~12% drop only shows up after our dashboard/merge step.

eval-bot: CI run 1758002000 finished with warnings: collector.merge: inconsistent-run-labels. See artifacts in ci/artifacts/1758002000.

mike: That points at the collector merge logic. If individual runs are fine, we might be mixing runs together when we compute aggregate ndcg. Check collector.grouping key.

rebecca: Good catch. If collector groups by dataset+model only we would mix float and quant runs. Did you inspect collector code?

sasha: Quick grep: collector/merge.py line ~72: ```key = f"{record.dataset}:{record.model}"  # used for grouping```. No config hash. :grimacing:

dinesh: Yep that's the bug. We never included config tags in the merge key. For quantized onboarding we need at least config_hash or a short tag like config.quantized=true.

mike: Minimal patch: append config_hash to key. Also add a unit test that creates two runs identical except for config and assert merge keeps them separate.

sasha: Drafting PR now — PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/9123
Patch snippet:```diff
- key = f"{record.dataset}:{record.model}"
+ key = f"{record.dataset}:{record.model}:{record.config.get('config_hash', record.config_str())}"
```
Adding test in tests/test_collector_merge.py.

rebecca: :thumbsup: can you also tag dashboard entries with config_label to make manual inspection easier?

sasha: Yep will add a dashboard tag. Kicking off full CI/eval after merge.

eval-bot: CI run 1758003000 started: unit-tests, integration-eval.

mike: Once CI finishes, re-run the onboarding quantized pipeline and compare. If aggregated numbers match fold-level expectation, we close.

sasha: CI passed. Re-ran onboarding eval (run_175803). New aggregate: ```quantized: ndcg@10=0.699 (+/-0.01) vs baseline 0.712 -> delta ~1.8%```. That's within expected quantization degradation. The previous ~12% was due to merged float+quant runs.

rebecca: Awesome. Please backfill dashboard entries where merge happened so historical reports are fixed (small script to reprocess merged artifacts).

dinesh: Filed ENG-ML-452: dashboard backfill + add collector regression test to CI gating.

sasha: Closing thread here. Root cause = collector grouping key omitted config hash. Fix merged in PR #9123 and cherry-picked to staging. Added unit test + dashboard tag + backfill ticket.

mike: Nice find and quick turnaround. :tada:

rebecca: Add a short postmortem blurb in the eval-harness docs so new onboarding runs mention the config_label requirement.

sasha: Will do. Thanks all.
